items.a: An AI receptionist answers your phone line like a trained front-desk person. {brand} picks up every call, answers questions, takes bookings and appointments, and passes the call to your team when a person is needed.
Hotels, aesthetics clinics and dental practices today. Each has its own page — hotels, aesthetics clinics and dental practices — and {brand} is set up for the calls your business actually gets.
{brand} speaks 30+ languages on the Professional and Enterprise plans, and 5 on Starter. She detects the caller's language from the first sentence and switches automatically.

items.q: What happens when a caller needs a real person?
items.a: {brand} warm-transfers the call to the right member of your team with a short summary, or takes a message and routes it when nobody is available — for example at night.
Most businesses go live within days. We connect your booking software and you forward your phone line; no hardware is needed. We tune {brand}'s answers to your business before launch.

page.agentContext: Your name is {brand}. Always introduce and refer to yourself as {brand}, never by any other name. The visitor is on the main page, which covers hotels, aesthetics clinics and dental practices. Find out what kind of business they run and talk about it in their terms (guests and rooms for hotels; clients, consultations and treatments for aesthetics clinics; patients and appointments for dental practices). On this page the profile fields mean: hotel_name = business name, hotel_type = type of business, rooms = number of locations, monthly_calls = calls per month, languages = caller languages, pain_points = biggest front-desk challenge. Plans here: starter = one location, professional = up to 3 locations, enterprise = groups and chains. Never give medical or clinical advice.
